pageSections.title: A bounded paper set makes synthesis traceable
pageSections.description: The Compare workspace receives the selected question and papers, then records which sources contribute to the result.
pageSections.caption: Cross-paper comparison interface from the public repository.

pageSections.title: Retrieval practice produces analyzable learning data
pageSections.description: A review attempt includes the learner response, self-rated confidence, grading output, revealed source, and scheduling update.
pageSections.markdown:
Refract scores the core claim, reference details, and faithfulness through structured model output. It records rubric hits, omissions, feedback, model name, prompt version, and source reveal mode. A human-grade export supports agreement checks against sampled attempts.

FSRS state schedules the next attempt. The planned retention study remains separate from the implemented instrumentation.

pageSections.title: Analysis records include predictors, audit decisions, and metrics
pageSections.description: Battery remaining-useful-life runs record column profiles, leakage findings, baseline results, Linear Regression, Random Forest, MAE, RMSE, R², and literature alignment notes.
pageSections.caption: Stats interface for the battery analysis workflow.

pageSections.title: Traceability depends on IDs and stored records
pageSections.description: The interface can expose provenance because the backend stores the links explicitly.
pageSections.markdown: PostgreSQL records relational data for sessions, papers, evidence, reviews, and analyses. ChromaDB indexes document chunks for retrieval. File storage holds PDFs and datasets. FastAPI routes validate operations across those stores, while the React/Vite client presents the five task-specific workspaces.
